author: v-Golubev
title: LLM accuracy CPU tests fail with HuggingFace 429 rate limit on model download
signature: 429 Too Many Requests you have reached your api rate limit|External Service

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy CPU tests / LLM accuracy CPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: HuggingFace 429 rate limit hit when downloading Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct model

key_errors:
huggingface_hub.errors.HfHubHTTPError: 429 Too Many Requests: you have reached your 'api' rate limit.
Retry after 3 seconds (0/500 requests remaining in current 300s window).
Url: https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct/revision/main.
We had to rate limit your IP (4.155.215.89). To continue using our service, create a HF account or login to your existing account, and make sure you pass a HF_TOKEN if you're using the API.
root_cause: The HuggingFace Hub API rate-limited the CI runner IP when trying to download/check the Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct model metadata. The cache was empty (model not found in local cache), so the test attempted a live API call which was rejected with HTTP 429. This is an external service transient failure unrelated to the PR changes, which only touch Snippets CPU functional test infrastructure.
reproduction_steps: N/A - rate limiting is external to the repository and not reproducible on demand.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'LLM accuracy CPU tests' job; rate limiting is transient and typically clears within minutes.
Ensure HF_TOKEN is correctly provisioned on CI runners so anonymous rate limits do not apply.
Pre-cache the Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct model on the runner before the accuracy tests to avoid live API calls.
prevention_strategies: Ensure the HuggingFace model cache (HF_HUB_CACHE=/mnt/caches/huggingface) is pre-populated with required models before merge-queue runs. Use authenticated HF_TOKEN to get higher rate limits. Consider retry logic in the test runner for transient 429 errors.
historical_context: This is the 3rd occurrence of this pattern (signature 391fe92c2ec33482). Previously seen on 2026-08-27 in runs 33081661909 and 33081710335.
